findings.issue: Meaning inverted: これだけしか知らない means 'I don't know anything but this', but lit_en claims the opposite ('the only thing I don't know; apart from this, I know everything'). Contradicts en, pt, lit_pt and the explanation.
findings.current: As for me, this is the only thing I don't know (apart from this, I know everything).
findings.suggested: As for me, other than just this, (I) don't know (anything).

findings.issue: Wrong reading: １週間 is pronounced いっしゅうかん (geminated), not いちしゅうかん.
findings.current: ぼくわこのしごとをいちしゅうかんいないにかたづけたい。
findings.suggested: ぼくわこのしごとをいっしゅうかんいないにかたづけたい。

findings.issue: Follows the kana reading error: 1週間 should be romanized isshuukan, not ichishuukan.
Token １ is read いち, but in the compound 1週間 it is pronounced いっ (いっしゅうかん); token reading must match the in-context pronunciation.
かたづけたい is desiderative ('want to finish'); en renders plain intention/prediction ('I will put this business through'), losing the たい nuance the sentence teaches. pt correctly has 'quero terminar'.
findings.current: I will put this business through in a week.
findings.suggested: I want to finish this work within a week.

findings.issue: Token list starts with stray out-of-order fragments 日本 and 語 (null glosses/roles) before マイク; 日本語 already appears as a properly glossed token in the right position. Concatenated surfaces no longer reconstruct the sentence.
findings.current: tokens: 日本, 語, マイク, は, 日本語, を, 話す, …
findings.suggested: Delete the two leading stray tokens 日本 and 語; keep the in-order glossed 日本語 token.

findings.issue: まあ、すばらしいわ is an exclamation that something is wonderful; 'My, but you're nice.' shifts the referent to the listener and the sense to kindness. pt ('Nossa, que maravilha!'), lit_en and expl all follow the 'wonderful' sense.
また in this farewell means 'again' (until next time), as expl_en itself states; 'Later too.' renders the additive sense 'also', the wrong sense here, contradicting the explanation.
findings.suggested: Again, later. (= see you again later)

findings.issue: Same error as lit_en: また here is 'de novo' (repetition), not the additive 'também'; expl_pt itself glosses また as 'de novo / mais uma vez'.
findings.suggested: De novo, depois. (= até a próxima)

findings.current: …da partícula けど ('mas', o alvo alvo).

findings.issue: そんな is medial deixis 'that kind of / such'; 'this kind of' corresponds to こんな. The pt gloss ('esse tipo de') is fine.
findings.current: this kind of / of that kind

findings.issue: Not a structural mirror: また雨だ is a nominal sentence (noun + copula), which lit_pt correctly mirrors ('De novo, chuva é'), but lit_en just repeats the natural translation with a progressive verb, misrepresenting the structure.
